<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Women&#x27;s Reservation Bill:</strong> The Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at providing reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass in the Lok Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPSTVKRHVGUXlhNjVqNEczYkNpd1NvbmRYOU5Fd2RIZjV3OHBob0owSzh3LVRXdUVqSDNVZTgtbVZlUG8ybS1wallfSVdTeTRtNENIU0lwV3piczdxV2NEVmE0WC1GSTQyMjR4dkNPb1pqblB2SzNHQjZBRWVXZHpPZXE2bVlQc3NGNEFJVU1NUHJMMFFqSkdRUVFFMGZNRUkzSTc0LXphM1JaLXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission Appeals:</strong> The ECI has informed the Supreme Court that over 37 lakh appeals regarding the Bengal State Identity Register are pending, requesting the establishment of 42 tribunals to address the backlog.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>BJP Election Strategy:</strong> Nabin’s tour of Uttar Pradesh signals a strategic push by the BJP to consolidate its campaign efforts ahead of the 2027 state assembly elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition Alliance Hurdles:</strong> The Samajwadi Party and Congress are currently facing significant challenges in finalizing seat-sharing arrangements for upcoming electoral contests.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Local Body Election Disputes:</strong> The Congress party has alleged that its party-backed councillors were detained in Haryana ahead of local body polls in Rajasthan, highlighting rising tensions in regional governance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
